_meta.title: SARAI — Specialty Indian Coffee House Redesign to Light Theme
_meta.author: E1 Creative Designer

design_philosophy.concept: Warm Sunlit Indian Verandah meets Third-Wave Roastery
design_philosophy.narrative_arc: From the morning sun pouring through teak jali screens to the warm terracotta warmth of Bengaluru's courtyards. In ancient Hindustan, a 'Sarai' was an oasis along trade routes where wanderers rested. The light theme reimagines SARAI as a sun-washed haven of hand-pressed linen, creamy steamed milk, warm aged brass, and deep roasted coffee bean ink.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Warm, tactile, grounded, artisanal, unhurried, literary, deeply Indian yet fiercely modern.
design_philosophy.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Craft System Archetype 1) with Swiss editorial typographic discipline.
anti_ai_slop_rules: NO purple/violet gradients (#7351B7 is strictly forbidden).
NO generic centered card layouts or uniform Bootstrap columns.
NO Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk for headings — rely strictly on Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, and Rozha One.
Generous spacing: 2x-3x typical density (py-28 to py-40 for major sections).
Asymmetry and tension: Roman arch image containers, diagonal scroll shifts, overlapping sticky ritual displays.
Contrast bands: Hero, Story, Ritual, Menu, and Visit live in luxurious warm light canvas; Footer retains dramatic deep espresso (#120F0D) anchor as deliberate contrast.

1_global_scroll_progress.spec: A top-docked 3px high progress bar (z-[60]) animated using framer-motion useScroll() -> scaleX. Background gradient: from #C28C48 via #DCA764 to #B94E34. Stretches left-to-right as user scrolls.

2_sticky_ritual_storytelling.spec: Replace the static grid with an editorial sticky scrollytelling container: On desktop (lg), left column holds sticky cards/tabs with active step progress, while right column features a large arched image showcase with floating brass dials, steam particles, and step-by-step extraction breakdown. As the user scrolls, active step smoothly synchronizes with tactile click/scroll snapping.

3_word_by_word_headline_reveals.spec: Scroll-linked / in-view word reveals using motion.span with staggered y: [20, 0] and opacity: [0, 1] with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), wrapping key phrases so words float up from crisp masked baselines.

4_dual_speed_parallax_image_pairs.spec: Parallax image wrappers using useScroll + useTransform: left image shifts [-12%, 12%], right image shifts [14%, -14%] to generate genuine optical depth as user traverses the story.

5_devanagari_ghost_floating.spec: Massive 'सराय' (Sarai) and 'कापी' (Kaapi) glyphs in Rozha One softly floating and translating down by 30-45% on scroll, colored at 0.05-0.08 opacity brass antique against warm cream paper.

interactive_states_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: All body text in #1A1512 or #4A3E36 against #FBF9F5 exceeds APCA and WCAG AA 7:1 ratio. Brass accents on white use #C28C48 with 4.8:1 contrast.
interactive_states_and_accessibility.hover_rule: Every hover state explicitly resets both background and text color to maintain crisp readability. No transparent hovers on interactive controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: In index.css, update CSS custom properties (--background, --foreground, --card, --primary, etc.) and html/body background to warm cream (#FBF9F5) and text to espresso-ink (#1A1512). Set scrollbar tracks and grain blend modes appropriately for light mode.

Step 2: Update public/index.html meta theme-color to #FBF9F5 and body style='background:#FBF9F5'. Ensure Google Fonts link includes Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Mono, and Rozha One.

Step 3: In src/data/cafe.js, update CAFE constant to explicitly DEMO data: address '404 Fictional Spice Lane, Suite #00, Caravan Quarter, Demo City 560000', coords '00.0000° N, 00.0000° E — ELEV 000M [DEMO COORD]', and update image URLs using the curated light-theme list in design_guidelines.json.

Step 4: In src/App.js, update wrapper container from 'bg-obsidian text-cream' to 'bg-[#FBF9F5] text-[#1A1512] min-h-screen selection:bg-[#C28C48] selection:text-[#FFFFFF]'. Add a sticky ScrollProgressBar component at top.

Step 5: In src/components/Hero.jsx, adapt all backgrounds, borders, and text classes to the light palette (#FBF9F5, text-[#1A1512], text-[#C28C48], borders in brass/25). Retain mouse-tilt arch and parallax ghost Devanagari 'सराय'.
Step 6: In src/components/MarqueeRibbon.jsx, style as a subtle warm ribbon: bg-[#F3EFE8]/80 border-y border-[#C28C48]/20 text-[#C28C48].
Step 7: In src/components/StorySection.jsx, set metric cards to clean crisp white (#FFFFFF) with antique brass figures and light linen backgrounds. Maintain dual-speed parallax image pair.

Step 8: In src/components/RitualSection.jsx, make steps scrollytelling-friendly with sticky image frame, crisp white preview card, and SVG dials tuned for light theme (stroke-[#C28C48] on stroke-[#C28C48]/20).

Step 9: In src/components/MenuSection.jsx, update category tabs to active pill #C28C48 with white text, inactive with subtle brass border on white; menu cards with clean border separators and cursor-follow preview card.
Step 10: In src/components/LocationHours.jsx, clearly highlight the DEMO nature of the address and coordinates with an elegant demo tag badge. Update hours table to white cards with warm borders.

Step 11: In src/components/Footer.jsx, keep the deep espresso obsidian (#14110F) dark band for high-contrast grounding as planned, but polish all typography and newsletter inputs with antique brass accents and clear demo disclaimer.
Step 12: In src/components/AiChatWidget.jsx, update drawer to crisp light crystal (#FFFFFF with 98% opacity, subtle brass stroke, clean warm assistant message bubbles).
Step 13: Verify all tests and test IDs remain functional with zero broken selector attributes.
